text: At Aulis, the winds died. A thousand ships lay motionless upon a stagnant sea.
The army rotted in the sun. Agamemnon watched from the high prow of his flagship.
Iphigenia walked toward the granite altar, her white linen robe trailing across dust.
Forgive me... the winds demand their toll.
She reached out to touch the gold inlay.
[TEMPORAL MATCH CUT] Three thousand years later... The sacrifice was never forgotten.
Kaelen's hand touched the glowing cyan conduit of Aulis-9.
An orbital core waiting for an identical sacrifice.
The thread connects what time separates.
